CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFMAILPARAM

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

CFMAILPARAM goes inside a CFMAIL tag. With FILE it attaches a file to the message; with NAME and VALUE it adds a header line of your own, such as Reply-To or X-Priority. Use as many as you need.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFMAILPARAM FILE="file_name">
  or
<CFMAILPARAM NAME="header_name"
    VALUE="header_value">

Attributes

FILE
Required if NAME is not used. Full path of a file to attach.
NAME
Required if FILE is not used. Name of the header to add.
VALUE
Optional. Value of the header.

Usage

Using the tag outside CFMAIL throws a Template exception. The attachment file is read when the spooler delivers the message, not when the page runs, so do not delete it in the same request. The MIMEATTACH attribute of CFMAIL still works for a single attachment.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFMAIL TO="someone@localhost"
        FROM="support@localhost"
        SUBJECT="Your Y2K readiness report">
<CFMAILPARAM NAME="Reply-To" VALUE="helpdesk@localhost">
<CFMAILPARAM NAME="X-Priority" VALUE="1">
<CFMAILPARAM NAME="Organization" VALUE="Gibson Mainframe Co.">
Good news: all 25 workstations passed the December 31, 1999 rollover test.
</CFMAIL>

<P>Message spooled with these extra headers:</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Header</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Reply-To</TD><TD>helpdesk@localhost</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>X-Priority</TD><TD>1 (urgent)</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Organization</TD><TD>Gibson Mainframe Co.</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
